tools.name: pdf_extract
tools.description: Given the URL of a public PDF, returns its text as markdown with tables as markdown tables, page by page (up to 30 pages per call, choose pages with e.g. 1-10), plus page count, title, word and table counts and pages that have no text layer. Parsed on Agent Harbor's own hardware; nothing is stored.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrape_business · Private data: scrape_business, company_card, sec_company, recalls, domain_verify, pdf_extract · Public sink: scrape_business, package_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrape_business · Private data: scrape_business, company_card, sec_company, recalls, domain_verify, pdf_extract · Public sink: scrape_business, package_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
